description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Purposes, Limits, terms & Conditions for Import & Export of Foreign currency or Sri Lanka currency
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the publication of an Order under Section 8 of the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017, which establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for foreign currency transactions. It contains detailed legal provisions, terms, and conditions for importing/exporting currency and holding foreign exchange, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
